description: This Java class defines a specific event type 'BulkBusinessEvent' that implements the 'Event' interface for handling 'BulkMessagePayloadV1' data in the context of loan transaction messaging within the Fineract project.

classes.name: BulkBusinessEvent
classes.description: Defines a custom event type for bulk business messaging related to loan transactions, providing event name and data class information, with an unimplemented ID extractor.

methods.name: getEventName
methods.description: Returns the string identifier of this event type.

methods.name: getDataClass
methods.description: Returns the class object representing the data payload type for this event.

methods.name: getIdExtractor
methods.description: Supposed to provide a function to extract an ID from the payload; throws UnsupportedOperationException as not implemented.
